title: Best Cardio Workouts
meta_desc: Discover the best cardio workouts at NZ gyms in 2026. Compare treadmill, rowing, bike, and stair climber exercises for calorie burn and HIIT benefits.
intro: Cardio exercises are essential for improving heart health and burning calories. With so many options available at NZ gyms, it can be overwhelming to choose the best workout for your fitness goals. In this guide, we'll compare the most popular cardio machines and provide tips for getting the most out of your gym sessions.

sections.heading: Introduction to Cardio Machines
sections.body: The most common cardio machines found in NZ gyms are treadmills, rowing machines, exercise bikes, and stair climbers. Each machine has its unique benefits and calorie burn rates. For example, a 30-minute jog on the treadmill can burn up to 400 calories, while a 30-minute rowing session can burn around 300 calories.
list: Treadmill: ideal for running and walking
Rowing machine: works multiple muscle groups
Exercise bike: low-impact and easy on joints
Stair climber: targets legs and glutes

sections.heading: HIIT vs Steady State Cardio
sections.body: Steady state cardio is still beneficial for endurance and can be less intense on the body. It's essential to find a balance between HIIT and steady state cardio to avoid plateaus and prevent overtraining.

sections.heading: Best NZ Gyms for Cardio Equipment
sections.body: If you're looking for a gym with a wide range of cardio options, consider checking out City Fitness or Les Mills. Additionally, many NZ gyms participate in Exercise NZ's subsidised gym scheme, which can help make your gym membership more affordable.

sections.heading: Get Started with Your Cardio Journey
sections.body: Now that you know the best cardio workouts and machines, it's time to get started. Remember to always consult with a doctor or a fitness professional before beginning any new exercise programme.
